verses.1: For the leader. Of David. In the LORD I take refuge; how can you say to me, "Flee like a bird to the mountains!
verses.2: See how the wicked string their bows, fit their arrows to the string to shoot from the shadows at the upright.
verses.3: When foundations are being destroyed, what can the upright do?"
verses.4: The LORD is in his holy temple; the LORD'S throne is in heaven. God's eyes keep careful watch; they test all peoples.
verses.5: The LORD tests the good and the bad, hates those who love violence,
verses.6: And rains upon the wicked fiery coals and brimstone, a scorching wind their allotted cup.
verses.7: The LORD is just and loves just deeds; the upright shall see his face.

notes.text: Foundations: usually understood of public order. Cf Psalm 82:5.
Their allotted cup: the cup that God gives people to drink is a common figure for their destiny. Cf Psalm 16:5; 75:9; Matthew 20:22; 26:39; Rev 14:10.
